question: Should QQBot continue supporting `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending that env var for the current SQLite/plugin-state model?
rationale: The source-level mismatch is real, but adding or retaining an env-controlled data root affects plugin storage, upgrade expectations, and security boundaries that repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Support a validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` diagnostic guidance and close or redirect the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support a validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot SQLite storage migration work makes this the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
